title: A special tour
text:
We received an enthusiastic and warm welcome from Miguel Martin from Sevillamoving.com. A knowledgeable and enthusiastic tour guide.
On the way there and back he told a lot about the area and history.
The tour along the coast and through the Donana National Park in the 4x4 is recommended. On the return trip we went to El Rocio, which was worth it.
We enjoyed.

Aafke and Jannes
author: 440jannesm
